**🐾 Krtko**

Krtko býva pod zemou, 

s lopatkami pracuje tmou. 

Hlboký si kope dom, 

V pokoji si spinká v ňom.

Oči malé, skoro slepý je, 

čuch ho k cieľu dovedie. 

Tunel vedie sem i ta, 

krtko vie, kde domov má.

en.text:
**🐾 Mole**

The mole lives down underground, 

his shovel paws dig all around. 

He digs himself a burrow deep, 

and there in peace he goes to sleep.

His eyes are small, he hardly sees, 

his nose will lead him where he pleases. 

His tunnels wind both here and there, 

but the mole knows his home is where.

cs.text:
**🐾 Krtek**

Krtek bydlí pod zemí, 

lopatkami ve tmě hrabe si. 

Hluboký si kope dům, 

v klidu si tam spinká v něm.

Oči malé, skoro slepý je, 

čich ho k cíli dovede. 

Tunel vede sem i tam, 

krtek ví, kde domov má.

hu.text:
**🐾 Vakond**

Vakond él a föld alatt,

lapátkezzel ás, halad.

Mély házat kapar magának,

benne szunnyad csendben, lágyan.

Szeme kicsi, szinte vak,

orra vezeti, merre hat.

Alagútja erre-arra,

tudja, merre van a vára.
